attempts.summary: Created a LUKS-encrypted, file-backed volume on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) mounted at /srv/secure, configured to auto-unlock and mount at boot via /etc/crypttab (keyfile-based) and /etc/fstab, using native systemd-cryptsetup-generator and systemd-fstab-generator units. Verified end-to-end by rebooting node1 and confirming the volume decrypted and mounted automatically with data intact, with a changed boot_id proving a genuine restart occurred.
